provenance: 2026-07-31 moc3 detector_blind_any (hfm #10 third artifact). delivery_confirmation_stall read 'delivery API unreachable/unparseable' for weeks on moc3 because the probe's only source was the MAP's :5000 HTTP relay -- and moc3 is role gateway-only with meshforge-map disabled BY DESIGN (the 07-24 deploy incident proved starting it there is itself a defect). The obvious cure 'the API is down, start/restart meshforge-map' must NOT be ratified: it re-runs the 07-24 self-inflicted incident. The honest cure shipped instead: the gateway publishes its full delivery snapshot() to ~/.local/share/meshforge/delivery_snapshot.json (atomic, ts-stamped, 60s cadence) and the probes fall back to that file when :5000 is unreachable, refusing stale/misshaped/future-stamped corpses. A blind detector on a box where the WATCHED ORGAN (the gateway) runs is a real coverage loss -- neither 'inert' nor 'restart the relay' is the answer; give the probe a source that exists on that box shape.
